goal: Implement C1 Honest Progress without changing selection, safety, synchronization authority or the user's wireframe.
acceptance: Participation excludes prepared-but-never-started, unfinished, abandoned and safety-stopped Routines; eligible Pause Today and started intentional stops remain represented.
Weekly and total recorded completions remain separate from deduplicated Participation Days, with stable captured-day grouping.
Progress exposes recorded skip and alternative details without physical-performance or benefit claims.
Unconfirmed legacy targets and Active-unlock achievements are absent from Progress UI; selection remains unchanged.
Existing failure, reset, protection, selection and UI regressions pass; independent review and all PR CI checks precede merge.
